item.title: Mimic Robotics Unveils Full-Stack Dexterity Platform After $16M Seed Round
item.summary: Mimic Robotics, a Swiss ETH Zurich spinout backed by a self-reported $16 million seed round, has unveiled a full-stack robotic dexterity platform combining the M1 tendon-driven hand, U1 data-capture wearable, and FLUX-mimic Video-Action Model — a development amplified by technology commentator Ronald van Loon on X.
